title: LoRA Training Metadata Entry
description: A single line in metadata.jsonl used for LoRA fine-tuning on Flux Dev

file_name.description: Relative path to the training image from the dataset root

text.description: The full caption/prompt describing the image. Should include the trigger word.
examples: TRIGGERWORD a portrait of a woman standing in golden light, antique setting

trigger_word.description: The unique token that activates the LoRA concept at inference time

weight.description: Relative training weight for this sample. Default 1.0. Higher values make the model see this image more.

tags.description: Semantic tags describing the image content, style, or subject

subset.description: Which training split this sample belongs to

drop_caption_probability.description: Probability of dropping the caption during training to improve unconditional generation. 0.0 = never drop.

resolution.description: Native resolution of the image. Used for bucketing during training.

crop_coords.description: Optional pre-crop coordinates if the subject is not centered

flip_augmentation.description: Whether horizontal flip augmentation is allowed for this image. Set false for asymmetric subjects.

notes.description: Free-text notes about this sample. Not used in training — for human reference only.
